text:
meera: Observing a regional p95 divergence in eu-west-1 after the 09:40 deploy. Traffic routed to v5.0.0 in eu, na still on v4.4.1. Small slice but consistent increase. Anyone oncall? :wave:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout 09:40 -> 09:55: eu-west-1 10% -> v5.0.0. Metrics: eu p95 +60% relative to baseline; errors minimal. Autotrigger: recommend regional failover (route fallback) due to latency_policy.

chris: I can take it. Quick triage: traces show higher scheduling waits in eu, but model kernels look similar. Might be a runtime kernel selection issue on that pool.

meera: Prefer regional failover then pining rather than global revert. Plan: 1) Pause eu rollout. 2) Failover eu traffic from v5.0.0 -> v4.4.1. 3) Pin eu route for change window. 4) Start INC-7542 and notify customers in eu.

ops_lead: Agreed. Use neutral language in comms: "performance stabilization in EU region". Also notify partner ops.

chris: Running commands now:
```
deployctl pause --rollout r-eu-555
deployctl regional-failover --region eu-west-1 --from v5.0.0 --to v4.4.1 --percent 10 --method staged
routes pin --route /v1/complete --region eu-west-1 --tag v4.4.1 --note "stabilize EU latency"
```

deploy-bot: Action performed: rollout paused (r-eu-555), regional failover started 10->0 staged. Auto-rollback suppressed due to operator action.

meera: Telemetry update: eu p95 returned to baseline within 90s. No customer errors reported.

eng-runtime: Filing INC-7542, assigning to runtime team. Will capture kernel selection logs and host-level metrics.

chris: Added short note to release notes: "09:40 EU canary to v5.0.0: regional stabilization applied; traffic failed over to v4.4.1 and EU route pinned for the window. Investigation ongoing."

ops_lead: Comms sent to #customer-comms: "We applied a performance stabilization step in the EU region during the scheduled change window. No action required; contact support if you see issues."

meera: For the postmortem capture: why regional kernel selection differed, operator decision to failover vs revert, and checklist to re-enable rollback automation when we have a kernel guard. Schedule triage at 15:00 EU.

deploy-bot: Post-action summary: type=regional-failover, scope=eu-west-1, from=v5.0.0, to=v4.4.1, pin=true, operator=chris (1771111160). Audit recorded."
